sources.title: Building and Construction Industry Security of Payment Act 1999 (NSW)
sources.fact: Section 5 coverage and exclusions are applied to the actual work and purpose; the skill does not make the legal coverage conclusion.

sources.title: Cadia Holdings Pty Ltd v Downer EDI Mining Pty Ltd [2020] NSWSC 1588
sources.fact: The judgment informs the purpose connection and mixed-work analysis but is not transferred mechanically to another contract.

sources.title: NSW payment and payment-schedule deadlines
sources.fact: Sections 11(1A)(b), 11(1B)(b), 11(1C)(a) and 14(4)(b)(i) preserve applicable contractual terms; keep their actual calendar unit or fixed date.

sources.title: Building Industry Fairness (Security of Payment) Act 2017 (Qld): payment and payment-schedule deadlines
sources.fact: Sections 73(1)(a) and 76(1)(a) preserve applicable contractual deadlines, subject to the relevant statutory limits.
